name: matdraw
author: Michał Kozieński, Weblance.pl
description: MatDraw – współdzielona tablica matematyczna (P2P WebRTC) dla korepetycji

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @matdraw/server && npm run build -w @matdraw/client
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @matdraw/server
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @matdraw/server && npm run test -w @matdraw/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @matdraw/server && npm run typecheck -w @matdraw/client
